status_meaning.SOURCE_CONFIGURED_RULE: Present in supplied input; not independent hardware verification.
status_meaning.DERIVED_FROM_MANIFEST: Exact arithmetic or explicit mapping from the supplied guest.
status_meaning.NARROWED_REFERENCE: A selected reference value; does not establish the full envelope.
status_meaning.SYNTHETIC_DEMO_INPUT: Invented numerical test input, not a guest specification.
status_meaning.MODEL_APPROXIMATION: Simplified method whose limits are stated.
status_meaning.UNVERIFIED_HOST_PLACEHOLDER: Host geometry/limit without supporting source in the guest/reference files.
status_meaning.SCENARIO_ASSIGNMENT: Selected state or resource assignment for a scenario.
status_meaning.CONSERVATIVE_BOUND: Explicit bound; not an actual operating demand.
status_meaning.MODEL_SCOPE_RESTRICTION: Coverage deliberately excluded and marked unverified.
status_meaning.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTATION_RULE: Executable integrity/mapping rule derived from supplied structured inputs.
status_meaning.SOURCE_RULE_WITH_LIMITED_IMPLEMENTATION: Source requirement implemented as a snapshot screen; additional temporal/operational evidence is needed.

assumptions.effect_on_results: All electrical margins move directly with this choice; shore-side resources do not validate at-sea admission.
assumptions.resolution: Supply a speed/load-dependent reserve table or evaluate explicit scenarios throughout the envelope.

sensitivity.basis: Sensitivity samples within Annex A.1 ranges already referenced by the project; not measurements.

assumptions.current_value: 150 kW per port/stbd line is configured; sample G1/G2/G3 port, G4/G5 stbd; both live initially.
assumptions.why: Branch capacities are in ship_specs. Guest cabling and post-trip line survival are choices in runtime, not guest-card requirements.
assumptions.effect_on_results: A lost or overloaded branch can fail while total power passes.
assumptions.resolution: Provide generator/branch connectivity; set explicit connections and available lines for each scenario.

assumptions.resolution: Obtain actual hangar interior/exterior envelopes and mounting allowance. Keep UNKNOWN in a source-only assessment.

assumptions.topic: Bay units and assumed equipment boxes
assumptions.current_value: Bay1 has two units; whole-Bay1 G3 box 6.1×2.4×2.6 m, half-Bay1 G2/G5 box 3.05×2.4×2.6 m; Bay2 boxes 3×2.4×2.6 m.

assumptions.resolution: Measure module envelopes; separate occupancy checks from geometry evidence.

assumptions.current_value: Mode-specific cores/RAM/accelerators/storage are in resource_profiles; all five source compute declarations are null.
assumptions.why: These are arbitrary executable test loads, not benchmarks or justified vendor estimates. They are retained to keep the demonstration runnable and labeled as assumptions.
assumptions.effect_on_results: Compute PASS is conditional on substituted demands. Deployed G3 now uses the intended surveying compute profile.

sensitivity.basis: Optional analyst stress multipliers, not a physical uncertainty range.

assumptions.current_value: 80% guest CPU/RAM per node; 80% shared storage; node4 accelerator reserved; integer guest total also limited on surviving hardware.

assumptions.effect_on_results: At four online nodes: 102.4 cores, 409.6 GB RAM, 16 TB, at most three whole guest accelerators; node4 allows none.
assumptions.resolution: Confirm reservation granularity and actual accelerator partitioning.

assumptions.current_value: G1→node1; G2/G3→node2; G4→node3; G5→node4.

assumptions.topic: Backbone aggregation and link upper bounds
assumptions.current_value: Configured maxima: 20,000 Mbps backbone; 8 SATCOM; 20 LOS; 0.005 acoustic.
assumptions.why: SATCOM/LOS/acoustic use chosen upper bounds; 20,000 Mbps assumes both 10 Gbps backbone links can be pooled. Redundancy alone does not establish aggregation.
assumptions.effect_on_results: Overstates availability if links are redundant or degraded; live capacities are independent inputs.
assumptions.resolution: Confirm topology. Use explicit runtime effective capacities.

assumptions.current_value: Default profile routes G1 0.2 and G2 0.5 Mbps to SATCOM; profile can select LOS. Silence suppresses these transmissions.

findings.finding: Installation action labels and durations were ignored; some operational source values were hard-coded.

findings.finding: The requested ship_state.py, constraints.py and snapshot.py interfaces were absent.

findings.finding: Snapshot checks do not schedule trajectories, thermal buffering, cranes, crew tasks, autonomy permissions, recovery alignment or the full mission envelope.
findings.resolution: Expose NOT_EVALUATED full admission and UNKNOWN source evidence; downstream decision/timeline engine must cover these.

integration: assumptions.json is the reviewable evidence register; executable values live in resource_profiles.json and ship_specs.json. Guest files override demo fields where source values exist. Use ShipState and snapshot.build_snapshot for live dict inputs, or snapshot.load_snapshot for files. After deliberate source edits review this ledger, refresh affected source_refs/hashes, regenerate docs, then run scripts/audit_assumptions.py. Do not blindly refresh source hashes to conceal stale assumptions.
